observations: Four car tires stacked on a concrete surface.
The tread pattern is a 4-ply design, characteristic of winter tires.
The sidewalls are embossed with a logo, but the text is too blurry to read.
A watermark 'CF GLOBAL POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center.
The tires appear to be used, with some dirt and wear visible on the tread.

claims.evidence: The embossed logo on the sidewall is not legible enough to confirm the brand and model.

claims.claim: Tread is still 90 percent, no patch, no bulge. Removed from a 2023 car.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the sidewall logo with the tread pattern visible.

risks.risk: The tires may be expired or have a hidden age stamp.
risks.proof: A photo of the 4-digit DOT code on the sidewall.

risks.risk: The actual tread depth may be significantly below 1.6mm.
risks.proof: A photo of a tread depth gauge inserted into the tread.
risks.if_unproven: as having very low tread life

proof_requests: Close-up of the sidewall logo to confirm the brand and model.
Photo of the 4-digit DOT code on the sidewall.
Photo of the tread depth with a gauge.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
